05 · SCOPE & METHOD

How to read these results

A transparent first-pass map, built to make follow-up review easier.

Sources & scope

ePrint records plus ASIACRYPT, CiC, CRYPTO, EUROCRYPT, JoC, PKC, RWC, TCC, TCHES, and ToSC. CHES maps to TCHES; FSE maps to ToSC. Collection window: 2017–2026 (final year year-to-date).

Classification

Explicit keyword rules assign specific directions from titles, abstracts, and keywords. Papers may receive multiple labels. 4,199 of 19,082 title-deduplicated paper records were assigned a label.

Coverage limits

Some venue records lack abstracts. RWC contributes talks, not proceedings papers. 2026 is incomplete; venue-year records may be unavailable or not yet indexed. Review labels and venue-year completeness before drawing strong conclusions.
